caption: The drawing shows two objects that resemble trivet stands, both in the shape of a pointed shield. The object at the top of the image is depicted in a brownish bronze color and features an openwork design. It includes a handle loop at the pointed end, decorative scrollwork, and integrally cast embossments: a pair of crossed objects in a rectangular frame at the top, a cluster of small round shapes at the center that resemble grapes, and a shield with vertical lines and a horizontal bar at the lower part. The bottom object is rendered in a pale gray color and appears to be a three-dimensional trivet with short legs, showing the same openwork design and embellishments as the top object but oriented horizontally, as if resting on a surface. Both objects are set against a plain, lightly textured beige background. The only text visible is the name “ORRIE MCCOMAS” in small uppercase letters near the bottom right corner.
title: Trivet
